import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
import dimod
import pennylane as qml
import pennylane.numpy as np
from pennylane.qchem import qiskit
import time

def get_graph(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    return G

def solve_graph_partition_qaoa(vertices, edges, known_reference_partition, p_layers=2, lambda_balance=0.5, lambda_cut=3.0, opt_shots=512, final_shots=2048, maxiter=60, n_repro_runs=3, seed=42):
    G = get_graph(vertices, edges)
    partition = known_reference_partition
    layers = partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial'] + partition['Layer_2_Shaping'] + partition['Layer_3_Assembly']
    Q, H, E = qml.QAOA.construct_graph(G, p_layers, dimod=True)
    objective = qml.QAOA.objective(Q, H, p_layers, dimod=True)
    initial_state = dimod.Sample(np.zeros(2 ** len(vertices)), vartype=dimod.BINARY)

    def penalty(x):
        num_cross_shift_handovers = sum(1 for i, j in edges if abs(x[i] - x[j]) == 1 and abs(partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial'].index(i) - partition['Layer_3_Assembly'].index(j)) > 1)
        return lambda_balance * num_cross_shift_handovers

    num_variables = len(vertices)
    num_constraints = 1
    qp = dimod.QuadraticProgram(num_variables=num_variables, num_constraints=num_constraints, objective=objective)
    qp.minimize(penalty)
    qp_result = qp.solve(initial_state, num_repetitions=opt_shots)
    best_params = qp_result.best_params

    best_state = qml.QAOA.state(best_params, Q, num_variables)
    best_state_dict = best_state.get_dict()

    sampler = dimod.Sampler(qml.device('default.qubit', wires=num_variables), n_repetitions=final_shots)
    qp_results = sampler.sample_quboid(qp, initial_state=best_state)
    reproducibility = np.mean(np.abs(best_state_dict['p'] - qp_results['samples'][:, :num_variables].T[:, best_state_dict['x']].mean(axis=1)))

    modularity_score = np.mean([qp_results['samples'][:, :num_variables].T[:, i].mean() for i in partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial']]) - np.mean([qp_results['samples'][:, :num_variables].T[:, i].mean() for i in partition['Layer_3_Assembly']])**2
    normalized_cut_score = 2 * np.mean([qp_results['samples'][:, :num_variables].T[:, i].mean() for i in partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial'] + partition['Layer_3_Assembly']]) - 1
    balance_constraint_score = (max(len(partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial']), len(partition['Layer_2_Shaping']), len(partition['Layer_3_Assembly'])) - np.abs(len(partition['Layer_1_RawMaterial']) - len(partition['Layer_3_Assembly']))) / max(len(vertices), 1)
    approximation_ratio = max(0, 1 - np.abs(modularity_score - normalized_cut_score) / np.max(modularity_score, normalized_cut_score))

    runtime = time.time() - start_time
    return {'modularity_score': modularity_score, 'normalized_cut_score': normalized_cut_score, 'balance_constraint_score': balance_constraint_score, 'approximation_ratio': approximation_ratio, 'runtime': runtime, 'reproducibility': reproducibility}
